meta.sources_note: Expansion batch 13 (DECISIONS 035, continuous expansion per DECISIONS 027, no per-batch approval): 5 new models, 17 quotes. Meta Catalog CLI run 2026-11-06 (20 rows per model; raw files data/meta_catalog_raw_{apple-macbook-pro-14-proled-xdr,sony-wf-c510,sony-inzone-h5,logitech-g-superstrike,keychron-b40}_2026-11-06.json, gitignored). Brand-direct / retailer prices verified read-only 2026-11-06 ~18:48-19:00 UTC (10:48-11:00 PT): no sign-in, no cart, no purchase. CORRECTIONS vs the 2026-10-31 candidate notes: (1) The PROLED XDR candidate 'from $2,899' is confirmed current — the pinned base 14-inch M5 Pro 15-core/16-core, 24GB/1TB, Space Black, Standard display (MJ2K4LL/A) is $2,899 at Apple direct and Best Buy; it is a distinct touchscreen tandem-OLED line, not the M6 (the set's apple-macbook-pro-14-m6 is the separate entry-level M6 line) and not the Liquid Retina M5 Pro (MGDR4LL/A, $2,499). (2) The WF-C510 candidate price $69.99 is the list price — the current street price is $58 at B&H, Abt and Electronic Express/Focus Camera, $59.99 at Best Buy, while Fred Meyer still lists $69.99. (3) The INZONE H5 candidate price ~$249.99 does not match any current US price — the current US street price is $128 at Focus Camera, Datavision and Abt (comp. value $178); Sony direct lists the White at $159.99 sale / $179.99 original (stale category crawl; the Black direct price was not confirmed). (4) 'Logitech G Superstrike' is a MOUSE, not a keyboard — the Logitech PRO X2 SUPERSTRIKE LIGHTSPEED wireless gaming mouse (910-007700, Lunar Eclipse), $179.99; the $199.99 Best Buy row is the newer PRO X3 SUPERSTRIKE (910-007876), a different model. (5) The Keychron B40 candidate price $49.99 is confirmed current at Keychron direct (Deep Black, the only variant, SKU B40-K9, Available). All five identifier sets stay pending (single-source UPC/EAN only — see catalog notes): PROLED UPC 195951196749 (Adorama spec table only), WF-C510 UPC 027242930339 (B&H spec page only), INZONE H5 UPC 027242927919 (Sony spec sheet via manuals.plus only), Superstrike UPC 097855211309 (B&H spec page only), B40 no UPC/EAN found anywhere (Keychron SKU B40-K9 only) — all recorded in the catalog notes, identifiers left empty per the Adaptive Controller / DualSense / PULSE Elite precedent. No Amazon touch: no Amazon quotes, no Amazon-sourced identifiers.
